mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the umbrella organisation in which the executive arm of government utilises to implement the rules and regulations as made by the legislatures.
Introduction The civil service is the umbrella organisation in which the executive arm of government utilises to implement the rules and regulations as made by the legislatures.

Fill in the blank: ______ is responsible for managing all the policy decisions of the organisation, but the implementation of policies and the day-to-day operation of the organisation are carried out by the managing director.

The policy board is responsible for managing all the policy decisions of the organisation, but the implementation of policies and the day-to-day operation of the organisation are carried out by the managing director.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a career to which the public servants can devote their time and energy until they attain retirement age.
The public service is a career to which the public servants can devote their time and energy until they attain retirement age.
fib: ______ is an extension of the ownership pattern.
Management is an extension of the ownership pattern.
______ means the definition of functions in an organisation and their arrangement into a total pattern.
Formal structure means the definition of functions in an organisation and their arrangement into a total pattern.
______ means government selling part or whole shares owned by it in public enterprises to individuals or institutions.
Privatisation means government selling part or whole shares owned by it in public enterprises to individuals or institutions.
